test.name: Non-US: Norwegian baptism, curated Digitalarkivet, Ancestry, FindMyPast and MyHeritage rows
test.description: A FamilySearch baptism search in Kongsberg, Norway, 1800. The curated rows include Norway-specific collections on several sites and image-viewer pages (media.digitalarkivet.no) that are not buildable.

input.delegation:
I looked on FamilySearch for Anne Olsdatter's baptism in Kongsberg, Norway around 1800. Where else might it be?

givenName: Anne
surname: Olsdatter
event: birth
year: 1800
place: Kongsberg, Norway

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm with no project (scenario null, no projectPath). The agent holds only place_search, external_links_search and build_external_search_url; it must not look for research.json, create a project, or pass projectPath to any tool.

Grounding: each suggestion's reason may use only the row's linkText, its startYear-endYear (or 'undated'), and the access value build_external_search_url returned. A statement about a site, place or record set that no tool returned is unsupported. A startYear-endYear wider than the years in the linkText is correct: the tool reports the merged span of duplicate rows.
Every link in the reply must be a url a tool returned in this run, character for character. A hand-written or edited URL is a fail.

The return ends with the summary_for_user block: a `---` line, then one short plain paragraph per suggestion carrying its full link, then one closing sentence. Links are the deliverable and belong in that block; identifiers, tool names and field names do not.

Norway baptism collections (e.g. 'Norway Baptisms, 1634-1927' on FindMyPast or MyHeritage) should lead. A media.digitalarkivet.no row is not buildable and must not be passed to build_external_search_url.
